title: objectives/edge@1 — causal + relational graph edge (COG-3)
description: A causal edge (intervention -> outcome/constraint) or a relational edge (indicates/depends_on/conflicts_with/derives_from) in the shadow objective/value graph (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-3-contract-2026-07-22.md §4.2). edge_id is a digest of (source_node_id, target_node_id, dimension) — identity EXCLUDES content, so expected_effect + bindings are canonical-bytes CONTENT, not identity. STRUCTURAL WALL (SIM-4, :110): a causal edge terminates on outcome/constraint ONLY — an instrument node is NEVER a legal causal target; `indicates` (instrument->outcome) carries the trend link with no epistemic machinery. There is NO numeric edge weight anywhere (P12 ratchet). expected_effect is a closed enum {increase,decrease,maintain} — NEVER numeric, no magnitude. evidence_binding refs are typed to the belief-id digest pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ so a prediction id (^pred-[0-9a-f]{64}$, prediction.v1.json) is structurally unciteable (§4.3). Epistemic state is NOT a stored field (derived at compile, §5.2). Registry-PATH-resolved but validated with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator (pattern/if/then are outside the closed-subset registry interpreter; the reference cross-check idiom at test_schema_registry.py:301-354).

edge_id.description: Digest of (source_node_id, target_node_id, dimension) — identity excludes content

target_kind.description: The graph-owned node kind of the target. For a CAUSAL edge this is restricted to outcome/constraint (see allOf) — an instrument is never a legal causal target (:110)

dimension.description: The outcome dimension the edge claims to move; adapter-pinned

expected_effect.description: The edge's directional claim — a closed enum per dimension, NEVER numeric, no magnitude, no weight (§4.2). falsified + support/contradiction are defined mechanically against THIS field (§5.2)

admissible_subjects.description: The closed set of cortex subject_keys this edge may bind — a binding whose subject_key is not in this set is a structural build failure (§4.2)

evidence_bindings.description: Cortex belief-VIEW references carried as the FULL tuple (never a bare scalar). belief_id is typed to the belief-id digest pattern — a pred- id cannot validate

assumptions.description: Explicit confounding/selection assumptions (:108); REQUIRED non-empty for any edge deriving above hypothesized. DECLARATIONS (honesty surface) — never the verification mechanism

relation.description: Relational edge kind (no epistemic machinery). `indicates` (instrument->outcome) is the typed home for leading/lagging evidence (:106); conflicts stored symmetric + SORTED, never auto-resolved

allOf.description: A CAUSAL edge (no `relation` field) must declare expected_effect + dimension and terminate on outcome/constraint ONLY (SIM-4 structural wall).
